runtime_policy: Pinned ExecEval-compatible rootless namespace runner; references pass every official hidden input in three stable repetitions. Python-language references use the private CPython3.11 rerun where applicable; Java and C++ use the recorded per-task runtimes. This runner is not the official ExecEval service.
eligibility_rule: Common-Core requires a passing canonical reference in Python, Java, and C++ for the same src_uid.
source_selection_rule: upstream exec_outcome PASSED; language parser valid; closest to lower median Qwen2.5-Coder-7B source token count; tie by ascending stable code_uid

precision.statistical_unit: src_uid cluster, retaining all six directions

precision.assumption: Conservative bounded paired difference in [-1,1] at the problem-cluster level; actual precision depends on model discordance/covariance.
